scope: Ten complete GCP scalar judges requests for LFM2.5-2.6B-QAD-Q4_0.gguf. Local final-output rubric; not official competition judging or the composite ADTC score.
policy: Only student-facing final text earns points. Separate reasoning_content and text inside <think>...</think> are excluded.
A nonempty answer field containing an unclosed <think> block is classified as reasoning-only, not as a final response.
When finish_reason is length but final text has started, fulfilled criteria in that final fragment may earn points; truncation remains reported.
The prohibition criterion earns no point when no final answer exists.
Weights and criterion labels are retained from the provisional local rubric; this is not the competition judges' official scoring process.
The existing rubric's concise-response bound is 500 characters; it is not replaced with a new exact-sentence-count scoring rule. A sentence-count deviation is separately flagged.
An empty final remains a delivery failure even if correct work appears in separate reasoning. The score measures delivery under this 1,024-token protocol, not unconstrained model capability.

source_snapshot.scope: Exact prefix captured from a growing append-only JSONL file. Individual record hashes exclude the newline.

independent_review.scope: Full independent reading of the three delivered outputs, automated_02/04/05, with corresponding reasoning.
findings: ODE earns zero: the final ends inside a derivative expression; correct solution reasoning is excluded. Count a partial final.
Chalk and photosynthesis earn ten each: correct options, calculation/biology and concise delivery.

The ODE final starts but ends inside an incomplete derivative expression. It is a partial final, not a finished answer or a reasoning-only response; it earns no criterion points.

limitations: These are provisional assistant assessments using the project's local rubric; no official judge score is claimed.
Ten prompts per model include a duplicate Two Sigma question. They are not ten independent samples.
All model runs use the exact recorded embedded templates and 1,024-token completion allowance. Higher output budgets or altered templates would be different experiments.
The GCP x86 CPU context is separate from the Mac Metal context; the two accuracy results are not pooled and no Mac throughput/RAM is substituted.
The lifecycle records establish the captured launch settings and matching model/server hashes; this grading task did not rerun inference or remeasure machine contention.
